summary.zh: DSH 侧栏 AI 生图工作台：图文与摄影两类流程，内置本地账号池，亦支持任意 OpenAI 兼容接口。
summary.en: A sidebar image-generation workbench for DSH: illustration and photography pipelines, with a built-in account pool and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）桌面端的图像生成工作台插件。左侧图文工坊可抓 AI 热点、生成公众号文章并一键配图；配图工坊提供图型/风格/主色调/出图指令/分镜五段式流程，直接产出可发布成图。图像接口默认指向插件内置的本地账号池，亦可配置为任意 OpenAI 兼容服务（Base URL / API Key / 模型）。支持自定义工作台名称与图片存储目录。
description.en: An image-generation workbench plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) desktop app. The content workshop grabs AI hot topics, drafts WeChat-ready articles and pairs them with illustrations; the image workshop runs a five-step pipeline (type / style / palette / prompt / storyboard) to produce publishable images. The generation endpoint defaults to the bundled local account pool and can be reconfigured to any OpenAI-compatible service.

caption.zh: 工作台主界面：内容工坊 + 配图工坊 + 排版预览
caption.en: Main workbench: content studio + image studio + layout preview
